title: Zoo Friends ABC
hook: Track the letter, name the beast!
A to Z, from west to east!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one beat with animal sounds reduced
visualStyle: friendly 3D zoo storybook, colorful habitats, non-scary animals, bold silhouettes, simple backgrounds

creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: two-line memory anchor whose orchestration changes on repeat
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 gives one visible habitat or body clue per animal and frames wildlife as something to observe respectfully, never chase or touch.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 uses track-and-name recall with gestures done from a safe observation spot; no chase, feeding or touching prompts.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: warm hand-drum or marimba footprint after the word.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: warm hand-drum or marimba footprint after the word
